name: Lucky Wheel
description: A spin event for the hero shards of your current generation. Spin to get shards, with bonus shards at set spin counts.
requirements: Points to spin come from other events: Hall of Chiefs (stage 2), King of Icefield (stages 2 and 3), and the SvS preparation phase (stages 2 and 3).
With 6 such events a free-to-play player can reach a 5-star hero.

rewards.name: Hero shard of the generation
rewards.note: Bonus for the 5th spin, 5 in total. The same number of Mythic Expedition and Exploration Skill Manuals is given.

rewards.name: Lucky Chip
rewards.note: Given on the 2nd day of SvS. The wheel costs 1,500 gems for 1 spin or 13,500 for 10.

tips: Mystery Pack: Mythic Exploration Manual ×2-4, Mythic Expedition Skill Manual ×2-4, 10,000 Hero XP ×5, and 1h Training, Research, and Construction speedups ×2-5.

Hero by generation (days after the state starts): Gen 1 Zinman (0), Gen 2 Flint (40), Gen 3 Mia (120), Gen 4 Lynn (195), Gen 5 Hector (270), Gen 6 Renee (360), Gen 7 Bradley (440), Gen 8 Gatot (520), Gen 9 Fred (600), Gen 10 Blanchette (700), Gen 11 Eleonora (800), Gen 12 Karol (870). The days vary a little.
A spin costs 1,500 gems, or 13,500 gems for 10 spins. You get 1 free ticket a day, can buy 5 types of gifts once a day, and get 5 lucky chips on the 2nd day of SvS.
You can spin up to 150 times a day.
Expected shards with the bonuses: 5 spins 7.7, 15 spins 23.2, 35 spins 54.1, 70 spins 103.3, 120 spins 180.6, 150 spins 197.0.
Spinning 120 times only with gems costs about 162,000 gems.

Shards needed for a hero (Mythic): 1 star 10, 2 stars 40, 3 stars 115, 4 stars 300, 5 stars 600 (cumulative 10, 50, 165, 465, 1,065). Add 10 shards to unlock the hero, 20 for Jeronimo, and 40 for Jessie.
The SvS Preparation State of Power tab shows a Lucky Chip reward of 5 and a Sunfire Token of 10 at the target chests.
